text: Was disappointed when I ordered a half sandwich and half soup and was charged for both items separately instead of obviously wanting the Pick 2 deal. I was upcharged $6 because the cashier rang the items up separately. Then the guy working there tried to make it seem like it was my fault for not specifying the Pick 2 when that should have been obvious. Poor customer service

We absolutely loved Revolutionary Soup! We stopped in while visiting Charlottesville and were so impressed. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and absolutely delicious! It’s one of those places that feels like a true local gem. The atmosphere was welcoming and relaxed, and it was the perfect spot for a casual meal. You can tell they take pride in what they serve, and it definitely shows. We loved our experience and will absolutely make a point to come back the next time we’re in town. Highly recommend!
I freaking love this place so much.

I love love love this spot for lunch and dinner. It’s affordable, delicious and consistently great. Whenever I’m hungry and close by I shoose rev soup because I know it’ll be quick and yummy. If you’re in Charlottesville and need a comforting meal for under $15 you should def stop by. The workers are always kind and helpful when deciding on which soup to choose from. My personal fav is the peanut tofu.

I got the pimento grilled cheese today, and they put about 1 teaspoon of the cheese ☹️ I usually like their food and recommend them to people, but with the $1 gluten free upcharge and tip I ended paying about $10 for like 100 calories, which is pretty disappointing. That was a pimento grilled cheese the same way lime la Croix is fruit juice. Get the soup instead.
Super salad!! I hope for a speedy recovery for their a/c.

It was a really cold day and we just happened to stumble in here. The inside of the place is super cute. All of the art on the walls and the tables are really cool. We ordered a special called the Ice Breaker (top of the photo) and a Ham & Brie (bottom of the photo). Both sandwiches were delish! We also ordered a Baked Potato soup to share. No complaints at all, we enjoyed it. Also the little corn bread that came with it was so yummy and subtly sweet. Perfect to dip in the savory soup.
Waited over 75 minutes for our food. Place was woefully understaffed to handle a moderate Friday evening rush. Food was plain and boring after a wait that long.

This was our first time visiting this establishment and will also be our last. The service was good but the food is another story. The steak and cheese sandwich tasted like it was made with steak-um. We also ordered 2 bowls of potato soup which is my favorite soup but not from this place it was a thin liquid not at all creamy as described on the menu with a couple pieces of bacon in it and not one sign of a piece of potato in either bowl. The chili is very spicy so if you can’t handle spicy don’t order that. The curry soup however was very good. It had great flavor and actual chunks of potato, If you like curry I would recommend this soup.

The food is decent, but it’s seriously overpriced for what you get. Portions are small, and the quality doesn’t match the cost. It’s fine in a pinch, but there are better options nearby that offer more value for the money.
Best soup on a cold day!
Loveddd the salad !! Soup also tasty and good small portions
The butternut squash soup was incredible today! Like mind-blowingly delish! And the little corn muffin is always the perfect treat to complement the soup!

The food here is amazing, but we just had a horrifying experience with their service. We came back from out of town, on a day we were already dealing with my grandmother dying. We did a Doordash order with them so we had food when we came back. We got a text saying they are making our order, then everything updated with Doordash all looked good and it said Dasher is approaching. When Dasher was 2 minutes away, we get another text from the restaurant saying they are remaking our order, and Doordash gives us a message that there was a problem with our order and the restaurant is making it at no extra cost.

We wait about an hour and multiple dashers come and go without picking up an order. We get concerned that the restaurant is about to close, so we call them, and they told us the Dasher basically took our order and ran with it, there was never another order being made, and they couldn't care less. This was after not only Doordash updated that they were making another order but also we got a text from *the restaurant* saying that they are making a new order.

The food is amazing, the service 0/10.
Probably the best Philly steak I ever ate! Seasonings were phenomenal, the loaded potatoe soup was good as well as the moist little cornbread!
Great gluten-free sandwich. Excellent vibes and ambiance
Delicious food and friendly staff! I love that there are multiple vegetarian and vegan options that actually have protein and aren't just a pile of vegetables like so many other places.
Best. Sandwiches. Ever.

I absolutely love this place! I come here about once a week for their soups and I’m obsessed. I work on the downtown mall and I can confidently say this is my #1 place! The staff is very friendly and fast!
We stopped for the first time today and we loved the sandwiches. I got a cheesesteak and it was amazing. My wife got a sandwich called the Adam’s Apple and she loved it.
Great service, great food.  I have been here several times and have never been disappointed.  Staff has always been friendly and service has been quick.
Our sandwiches (cheese steak and kickin' chicken) were delicious!  The man who took our order was very friendly and patient as we decided what to pick.

What a hidden gem!!!!! This feeling is only enhanced when you walk through the door to this quaint yet spacious reprieve from your day. The staff is amazing and the customers always smiling. Got a great recommendation and was totally satisfied. I didn’t order one but watching their perfectly crafted wraps being served was tempting. The wraps were layered evenly and looked picture perfect. This is a place you MUST seek out when in the area.
Drove from Richmond to enjoy soup!

I feel the revolutionary spirit. Every time I’m here I want to revolt against the kitchen for the ridiculous wait times for a sandwich and a cup of premade soup. 45 minutes is enough for me to wait another few years before coming back. The soup’s great though , can’t argue with that.

Tasty healthy soups and other fair, prepared to your order from the counter (and you pick them up when they are done). Lots of good vegetarian and vegan options. Friendly and colorful staff.

The place has unusual decor. Cool old TWA and Air Italia travel posters on the walls. Reasonably priced (not cheap) but reliably something which is better to eat than a corporate chain and your money stays in the local economy. Strange multi layer floor plan is interesting. Minimalistic settings and ambiance.
Love this place! One of my favorite in Cville... kind of tucked away but easily found. Great soup and sandwiches
Truly a Charlottesville institution, Rev Soup has been a staple on the DTM for decades. Reliable, consistent, and delicious. One of our favorite spots.

Went with the Spicy Chicken Tortilla soup. I personally feel that it’s missing some key ingredients and it was more of a tomato basil chicken soup than anything else. Missing beans, corn cilantro, cheese and tortillas! Yes provided some small amount on tortillas strips.
Good food great price!
Pimento cheese sandwich was a joke
Relishing farm to table local spot! Not very easy to access though.

I write this after my last three visits. The corn muffins used to be light and slightly sweet. The last three were flat, dry and had no resemblance of the muffins that I used to enjoy.
Today I had the crab chowder. I could not taste crab in the stock and the fish appeared to be tilapia.
I will not return.
One of the best lunch or dinner spots. Can’t go wrong with anything on the menu
A hole in the wall and that is a good thing. Great soups and sandwiches in an eclectic setting. Who could ask for more?

A very warm, comforting food experience I had at this place. The soups and sandwiches are amazing. Freshly cooked, warm, and very refreshing flavors. Nice intimate place for communal eating. A must winter place to visit.
Really warm and nourishing, in every way! Great, deliciously cooked food, lovely ambience! A winter refuge ☺️

On a cold, rainy fall day, a bowl of hot soup is a great idea. If you're in this town, make sure Revolutionary Soup is providing that soup.
They have a pick two option that lets you try a half sandwich (served as a wrap) and a small soup. We each had one plus a third small soup on the side for a total of five menu options. Every single one of them would be worth having again on their own. Among the soups, though, the lamb curry truly stood out as an outstanding flavor. Both the Kickin' Chicken and Thai Chicken wraps were amazing.

This was a wonderful find. I'm in town for a conference and I really enjoyed the food. I was blown away that the corn muffin was sweet. I have never had that outside my grandmothers home. It was a wonderful surprise. I will visit again.
Good food...Good service....Good variety of food choices
Good soup, small portions, expensive
Consistently good! We love their soups and quesadillas.

I've been going to Revolutionary Soup for as long as I can remember, and I've always enjoyed their food. But lately, I've noticed that when you order takeout, they skimp on the ingredients. The last few times, I let it slide, but last Friday was the last straw. I emailed the restaurant with photos of my order because everything was missing ingredients that were clearly listed on the menu. It feels like they assume you won’t notice when you eat at home, but I definitely did. It's so frustrating to spend $30-$50 on a meal and be left with pure disappointment. I used to order from there once or twice a week to make life easier, but after they didn’t even bother to respond to my email, it became clear they don’t care. I’m done with their subpar service and lackluster menu.

I almost put four stars but then felt guilty. The reason being the portion sizes seem small for the price, but I'm going to add the caveat that I live in a rural area, where things are dirt cheap. So it's likely my bias. That aside, the food was great. I got a ham and brie and they had gluten free bread which is always exciting. Gluten free is well marked on the menu. overall, a nice little lunch spot.

Food is good but not consistent. Ordered a grilled cheese and they forgot to add their special herbal blend to the bread, went to the front to let them know and was told “oh, we have someone new in the back”. This is not the type of customer service I expected. Had to ask for a refund.
The food was incredible, can't wait to go back and try more things from their menu! There's several Veggie + Vegan options that look divine 💚

Revolutionary Soup is my go-to eatery. I never miss out on their Nak Attack Burger and a soup and occasionally I treat myself to their salad too. Their drink selection, especially the kombucha, never disappoints. The staff is not only friendly but also incredibly patient. A special shoutout to the manager, Nikki, for always ensuring a smooth and enjoyable dining experience.
Great place with delicious sandwiches and soups.  We had the 90s Club Sandwich and Lamb Curry.  Both were a  great meal to have before enjoying a show at the Jefferson.

The food is great. However, they are absolutely NOT wheelchair accessible so in order to enjoy their fine food, I have to be carried in down multiple flights of stairs. Usually, we opt to carry me to a table. Someone orders for me, and then we sit together.  Love the atmosphere, but I wish I could actually enjoy it.
The place looks good but the food is not what I expected. Overpriced, very mediocre, won’t ever go there again. Really doesn’t match the price
Good soup
Got my order wrong and gave m meat. Not a good look for a place that advertises vegan options.

It's such a sad day when they are closed! Even in the summer you can enjoy a cup of their soup and a nice sandwich. I always find myself wanting to swing by to the cozy quiet alcove and enjoy some amazing food. I highly recommend the potato soup.

I thought I'd try this place based off reviews but it was not only very low quality food, but extremely overpriced. One small cup of tomato bisque and a mozzarella sandwich cost $20. The tomato bisque had a very bitter taste too it and was hard to imagine how one can mess up such a simple comforting food. The pesto mozzarella sandwich was something which a teenager could make at home. The bread quality was as if it was from a supermarket not a bakery. The price, hence, was completely unjustified. I never thought I'd leave feeling unsatisfied by a staple combo of a tomato soup and sandwich, but I rather would have dined at a Panera bread even. To top it off, there was nothing as customer service and the establishment was extremely dirty, with pieces of food all over the floor and tables, with no one cleaning the area for the hour I was there for.
Litterally only one spec of chicken in the Medium “chicken” tortilla soup. Complete waste. Dont order
Had great Latte. Atmosphere was nice. Service was good. We just had a coffee
Rev Soup makes the best soup, so delicious!
I loved the soup

Went for lunch on a weekday. They weren't too busy and we were able to get a table and get our food without too much wait. We both ordered a pick two. I had a ham and brie wrap which was really good and a ceasar salad which was just okay. Overall the restaurant was neat and I will probably go again, but will not be ordering the salad again.
Great lil adventure. Everything was fresh and lovely. Great menu. Fun!

I cannot shake that a number of years ago I found a huge plastic chunk in my hot soup from something accidentally falling in.  I lost confidence in the place.  I can only hope that now employees take more care…
Hungarian Mushroom soup was fabulous. If it is on the menu the day you visit it is not to be missed. It came with a delicious muffin that I didn't know would be included.
Good vegan options

The chocolate Chip cookie slaps.
Soups were spot on.
Kickin Chicken Sandwich was top tier.
Corn muffin complementary to my soup which was a classy move. Great tunes. It was in fact Revolutionary.
I will be back. Thank you for a great lunch 💪

So good! Great spot for a tasty, unique, reasonably priced meal. We had a spinach salad, lamb curry soup, tomato soup, and crab and corn chowder at our table and all were excellent. Bonus: soups come with corn muffins, yum!
Amazing soup!

Unique soups and sandwiches! It was hard to decide bc everything on the menu looked amazing!
I love they allow you to sample a soup upon request. After sampling 4 soups (all of which were AMAZING) I chose a small Potatoe Rosemary which was incredible! Also ordered the NAK burger which ranks up there with one of the best burgers I've ever had. My group got some sandwiches which they also loved (club and turkey apple). The corn muffins that come with the soup was also very good. Can't wait to go back next time I'm in Charlottesville.

my soup was good my soup was tasty
they even got it to me hastily
I also heard music that I adore
fall out boy and paramour
what was my meal cost this day?
extremely reasonable I'd say
the next time I'm in town
I'll come back for soups abound

A group of 6 friends went to grab a quick bite to eat last night and got there about 7:25pm. We were quickly told that they close at 8 so if we were dining in, we needed to hurry up and eat. So we ordered the food (all of us got half a wrap and a cup of soup) and sat down. There were several people who were turned away before 8 because the people working said the kitchen was backed up and made sure to let them know they closed at 8. As we were waiting the person who I assume was the manager, told the other lady working to go start stacking chairs and make sure to bang them loudly. So as we all sat there waiting, the one worker slammed chairs together as she stacked them, apparently to encourage us to never come back again, because that’s what we are going to do. I also have issues with loud sounds and it was giving me so much anxiety that by the time the food came, it was hard to enjoy it. We finally got our food with about 8 minutes to spare so we all inhaled everything and left. I think we were out of the door at 8:03pm. They were so rude and it was the WORST service any of us have ever received. It’s unfortunate because the food was delicious and my family has enjoyed getting take out from there on many occasions. I’ve never felt more disrespected as a paying customer in my life. Don’t get me wrong, I’ve worked in a restaurant before and I’m sure there were times I wanted to go home at the end of the day but we weren’t being rude or trying to take forever to eat, and I NEVER would’ve treated a customer the way they did.
Great soups. Peanut Tofu one is our fav

It's like that super cozy unassuming dive bar you loved in college, but with delicious soups and sandwiches instead of PBR.

Unpretentious but well-made and delicious food in a laid back space. Lots of options for dietary restrictions, and they serve half-wraps and soup/sandwich combos for those who have trouble choosing just one thing. The "classic combo", which I'm pretty sure used to be the "student combo" gets you a grilled cheese and small soup for like $8 - a steal these days.

It's often super busy at lunch time but they're efficient and the line moves quickly.
So good! Eat here!
Soup & burgers excellent! Cafeteria style service, a bit confusing if you've never been there. Wraps were okay. I would definitely go back for the soups alone!
Nak Burger was great.
Small shop, food was delicious, limited beer selection. No real parking near the restaurant.
Best burger in Charlottesville, I’m pretty sure.
Nothing like a soup and sandwich place. And this place is fantastic! Great quality and fast service.

Revolution Soup was a culinary high point of our short stay in Charlottesville.  Quick to the counter, ease of ordering, great selection of ready made soups, short wait for salads and sandwiches, plenty of seating.
Great spot for a quick meal. I’m vegan but my Mom is not. We were both able to find something we enjoyed. The tofu sandwich was hearty and filling. Casual atmosphere.

We ate here for the first time tonight. Both of our soups were perfect and we will definitely go back. Caesar salad was nice and fresh but a little boring and could have used more dressing. They have a lot to vegetarian options and service is fast and friendly. There are a lot of stairs to get inside so it’s not accessible to wheelchairs unless there’s another entrance I didn’t see. Affordable healthy option for sure!
Great food. Parking a little challenging
Always good food and good people
Great little spot on the side street of the mall. Folks were friendly and helpful. Soup and wrap were a delight!
Best soups in town.
Very very good salad!!
A must have while in CVille! I used to live here and it holds up just as well 4 years later. No bad thing on the menu!
Secret "off the beaten track" spot for amazing soups and sandwiches.
We've been patronizing 'Rev Soup' (as we refer to it) for many years (as of summer 2023), and it's been pretty consistent in offering delicious, nutritious food at modest prices.
My absolute favorite lunch spot in Charlottesville. The Peanut Tofu soup is a LIFE HACK.
Something changed, it used to be my favorite place in town
I loved this place! Great vegan and vegetarian options - I highly recommend their potato leek soup
Love this place, I go at least twice a week can't get enough.

The customer service here is abysmal

They refuse to take orders over the phone and then they have the nerve to have a $10 minimum to place a pickup order online.

Why do I have to wait around for my food just because I want less than $10 worth?

I will be taking my business elsewhere.

I went for the Spicy Peanut soup, but also went away with a quart of the Hungarian Mushroom Soup! It was amazing!!!!! It could also be used over pasta with broccoli. The curried chicken salad was delicious. It didn’t even require the dressing. Friendly staff and local art for sale at a reasonable price.
Soup was cold and it took a long time:(

I've gone three times in the past month and I love that there are new specials popping up. The first soup I had was an alligator bisque for mardi gras. I wasn't crazy about the texture of the gator, but the soup was really flavorful. The white soup is the loaded potato which is always the bombdiggity comfort soup. And the last soup is their Hungarian mushroom which is so yummy and flavorful. I'll probably get it this weekend too. They also have sandwiches, wraps, salads, quesadillas there too.
Everything is amazing!!
Frickin' Amazing Soups!!
Fantastic rotating soup options. Sandwiches are delicious as well. Soups come with a choice of dinner roll or corn muffin.
Really great little spot with cozy vibes. Great soup and sandwich options and struck me as a local favorite.
Great sandwiches
Excellent!

Wow! If you love soup even a fraction of how much I love soup, you will LOVE this local soup joint! Their menu changes everyday and they make all of their delicious and unique soups from scratch! They have a little something to offer anyone from the beefy, chili-type, meat lover, to a light, vegan, veggie-lover! I already knew I wanted to try something I never had before but if you happen to be into more "traditional" flavor soups and styles they have you covered as well!

Upon entering the tall, shabby-chic, storefront door, we walked down into a set of small steps which brought us down to the restaurants and eating areas! The walls were decorated with lost of nostalgic records, posters, art, as well as other interesting pieces of furniture. Just my style! I love all the downtown historic buildings and treat most of them as a little museum during my short time there!

I proceeded to the ordering counter where I decided to order a choose two with the 90's Club and a side of the Creamy Edamame soup! My friend chose to also order the choose two but he opted for the Mozzarella and Pesto wrap with the Corn Chowder. The drinks are offered at the front by either choosing from the bottled drink section near the counter or the fountain beverages. I opted for just a coup for water this day as well as my husband.

After ordering our food, we were given a number to wait and we found seating. The food was prepared quite quickly, maybe 4-5 minutes and came out hot and delicious! My creamy edamame soup had a very rich edamame, spinach flavor which I personally loved but I could see some thinking it may be salty. My 90's Club (pictured) was the highlight of my whole day! It was huge, the chicken was tender, avocado was fresh, the sauces were perfect (enough to barely make it a little soggy... MY FAVORITE), and just all together felt deliciously guilty to eat! My sandwich was bigger than my friend's !

As for his meal he really enjoyed it and anytime corn chowder is offered he get extremely excited! It had a really nice flavor and texture in my opinion. His mozzarella and pesto wrap was what seemed like the perfect light lunch snack to me. Wrapped nicely, fresh ingredients, vegetarian. I could. Probably eat at-least two of those!

Overall I plan on going for the rest of my stay in Virginia and I'm excited to try more of the soup flavors and sandwich options! They even have bone broths, cheese steaks, salads, burgers, grain bowls, and quesadillas! Can't wait to go back! Give them a try!

The food here is overall good but the prices have always been high and now even more so.
I don't like that their half sandwiches are really just wraps.
Although very convenient to where I work I'd rather go to Bagsbys for a good sandwich.
Convenient, comforting, and delicious. Crab and corn chowder is a favorite and I'm so happy it's back.

What a great little place to stop by. They have good food, and the service is great! I loved the selection of soups.
I ordered the spicy peanut soup, super flavorful and tasty. Also ordered a Caesar salad that I didn’t love, the dressing wasn’t good. Overall I recommend it

My mom and I came here by recommendation and I am so glad we did!! I had the tomato basil bisque with grilled cheese combo and it was perfect! *chefs kiss*. Hope to come back and get something else next time.

I ordered food with my friends. We were just talking about how good Revolutionary soup was but today was so upsetting I ended up throwing my food away.
I know for a fact whoever is in the kitchen is not reading the recipe right
Smaller portions but food was high quality (soup especially)! Muffin corn bread with soup was so delicious!
Amazing food
The food was edible but not outstanding. A bit overpriced for the portions. I would not recommend. $4 for a Peach Honest Tea???-they cost $1.25 at Food Kitty, guys...gee...
Delicious food. Good vegan options as well. The grilled tofu sandwich is amazing!

The venue is interesting, and the staff is very friendly. However, the food left much to be desired. I had the Thai chicken wrap, and my husband had the chicken tortilla soup and a Caesar salad. All of it was bland as if little to no seasoning was used. My husband described the soup as "tomato soup with chicken in it" and the Caesar dressing as if it had been mixed with ranch. I am bummed! We picked the restaurant based on its positive reviews, but we won't be back.
Always great soup and sandwiches. Cozy cellar atmosphere.
Menu makes the options sound way more appetizing than what you get. Food was pretty bland
Not so tasty

Delightful lunch. As we descended into the restaurant, we were enveloped by the wonderful aromas. I wanted to try every single soup! We each got a sandwich and soup combo to try more of the offerings. Didn't get a pic because we gobbled it up so quickly! Thai Peanut Tofu Soup and the Potato Rosemary Soup were stellar. Also enjoyed the mozz/basil wrap! Really love all the veggie/vegan options!

Was in Charlottesville for an appointment and stopped in for lunch. If you’re vegetarian or vegan check your food closely. My husband and I split a Thai Tofu wrap and a Local Grilled Tofu wrap. Two bites into the Thai wrap I was thinking the tofu was a really weird texture. Because it was chicken. While I was offered a refund that wasn’t the issue. I didn’t need my $5 back - I needed a way to not have eaten chicken. We won’t be back.
Always the best !
Exceptional soup and sandwiches...the pureed rosemary potatoes soup was the best I ever had.. as close to perfect as a soup can get .. what a gem after visiting Monticello....
This is one of the best soup shops it’s so fairly priced and wonderful absolutely word stopping for lunch

Tucked away off the main street of the downtown mall is Revolutionary Soup. Don't let the name fool you it serves so much more although the soup is great! They have a variety of vegetarian and vegan options in addition to amazing meat based dishes. I got their two specials, the mistake burger, and the borst soup. Both amazing dishes that I would recommend anywhere. Highly recommend as either a lunch or dinner option for anyway of the week!
Spectacular food, reasonably priced.. Has a definite hipster/classic soup kitchen feel yet it also seems pleasant and non-judgemental. Good beverage and chip selection.
Good food at reasonable prices just off the downtown mall
Amazing quality of food.  I use them quite often for work lunches and always prompt service with freshness and very good tasting.

This place is a staple now. Every holiday we visit the folks in C'ville we make sure to hit Rev Soup. They were out of a couple soups Dec 2021 (due to supply chain yada yada).
My favorite was the cheesesteak wrap with cup of Lamb Curry (pic). Both were excellent. Wish the wrap was a little bigger tho. Lamb Curry so tasty it "silenced" my appetite.
Vegetarian wife had their Bruschetta sandwich (pic). She loved the pesto and everything was fresh.
Sister had grilled tofu wrap with cup of Tomato Bisque (pic). Thumbs up.

The place is really fantastic, the workers are wonderful people, the soup is good and innovative, the art is cool. Quite literally the only bad thing is the price, great for a snack, not for a meal like dinner.
tomato bisque and potato soup were good. wraps were filled well.

Best soup in Va., hands down, and it's not even close. Blown away by the potato rosemary soup, which had a nice, thick body, and was extremely flavorful, with the potato on the front end, and the rosemary coming through on the finish. Awesome vibe/ambience/well-decorated, too.

Had a bad experience through Door Dash and the manager contacted me right away after my original review. I got to try a fresh bowl of the Tomato Basil soup. SO FRICKING GOOD. Best I've had since I was in culinary school. Hard to get to, but so totally worth it.
Unique and tasty!!! A downtown gem!

My favorite place to take visitors for lunch.... Especially if I don't know if they are gluten free, vegan, or have other food issues. There is something for everyone. The peanut/tofu soup and ham/brie sandwich are my favorites. So glad they are surviving these tough times.

Food was OK, we always like to stop at different places when driving through places on vacation, it cost a family of 7 $90, way over priced I think, could've went to the store and paid $20 for everything to make wraps for the whole family.

Superb soups, salads and corn bread on a scorching August day. Perfect ambiance with Elvis playing on their system and great décor. Jared was super nice to play with our seven year old who loved their grilled cheese. Rosemary potato soup is a must.
The spicy peanut tofu soup is excellent and made come back for more.
It's been 5 years since I frequented here but I can only imagine it's as tasty today.
Delicious! Great prices, amazing food!

Wanted to try something local. Glad we did. The steak and cheese was the best sandwich out of the three. The potato rosemary was smooth and flavorful. The other soups were good. The BLT is an easy classic. The only drawback was the Adam was turned into a wrapped and sadly was very dry.
The location on the downtown mall always provides great customer service and the soup is consistently good.  I always go for the loaded potato soup.  Delicious!
Great soup and sandwiches! Would definitely come back.
Best soup in town, make sure you try their Spicy Peanut Tofu.
Awesome place and awesome staff!!
Great soup.  Good prices.  Great tunes playing in the background.

So Rev Soup is my “go to” on DinerDash. I’m working on trying all their soups...well most of them. I adore the mozzarella pesto on sunflower wheat and get that lately with tomato bisque which ROCKS!

So healthy and yummy. I do wish nutrition info was available on website.

Thank you for awesome food!

This place was amazing!! Simple ingredients but soooo FRESH! The combinations of tastes were so good! I would have never thought to pair some of the tastes they did together but there were too many things that sounded so good! I wish we were in town longer to sample more!! They also have a combo option to try 2!
Anyways! I had to Adam’s apple and my husband has the Thai wrap and tuna salad. It was fresh, tasty and so satisfying. Glad we chose here of all the options downtown. When we visit again, we will be choosing this as a lunch option!!

I'm not sure if it was the staff that day or if their quality has gone down but it wasn't that great last time I went. I highly recommend trying it a couple more times before deciding because it's a small business and they might have just been having an off day, but I was disappointed in my order. The crab and corn chowder had a scent to it that it doesn't normally have and was a lot thinner and expected.

Rev Soup is my go-to lunch spot when in Downtown C-ville. I have never had a soup or sandwich from here that is anything less than amazing. The quality is excellent, the portions are generous, and the service is always friendly.
Good food. Good portions and very economical.
Delicious soup and sandwich selection. A Charlottesville must visit!
Yummay!!!
Tied with Thyme & Co for the best food in Charlottesville, in my opinion.
Soups are wonderful and delicious. But their sandwiches are gross. The ham and cheese was disgusting and made me sick within the hour after eating. I’d recommend only eating their soups.

They are unsanitary. They handle the food, cash register at the same time. The place is not clean. Today I saw the guy at the cash  register  use his gloveless hands to prepare a salad. I asked for a refund immediately. I stood for several minutes observing them as they busily prepared the food with no hand washing, no masks and no gloves. I won’t ever be going back there. My stomach churned at the lack of attention to cleanliness when preparing food to serve to the public especially during this time when COVID is rampant.

Soups are delicious, as one might hope for given the name.  We especially love the peanut tofu.  The wraps are also excellent. Whether you're a Cville resident or just passing through on a whirlwind tour of this foodie paradise, "Rev Soup" (as the locals call it) is worth a visit. A true hidden gem, this place hits all the bases: a delightfully friendly and quirky staff, cozy underground digs, the freshest ingredients sourced from local farms (Charlottesville was a pioneer in the locavore movement after all), and a few chess/game tables to serve the likes of both the bearded hipsters and the bow-tied frat boys stopping by for a momentary reprieve from the stress of street-level life. Do yourself a favor and splurge on the full experience, because a great cup of soup should never be served alone. Go for the You Pick Two special, and pair a Potato Rosemary soup with a nice Caesar salad, or (my personal fave and Cville legend) Spicy Senegalese Peanut Tofu soup with a Classic Quesadilla. Sure to please both the vegan and meat-lover in your life, this is a great spot for a rainy day, a non-fussy first date, or a group study session break. Bring $10; leave completely heart-warmed.

My first visit I had admittedly high expectations due to hearing from every angle how good it is. Unfortunately, my experience was left well short of those expectations. I'll start out by saying that the soup I got WAS incredible. The Corn and Crab chowder was not lacking in either corn or crab amd it was served piping hot, with a (rather stale) roll. They were however out of Tomato Soup and the Spicy Chicken Tortilla which I personally was keen to try. My sandwich came out looking spectacular, loaded with chicken, bacon, and chipotle mayo. Unfortunately, it waited on the consolidators counter for nearly 10 minutes while they failed to put together the simple Greek salad my girlfriend had ordered. After a reminder, they quickly threw together the salad, and when I returned to my seat i quickly realized there was no feta or olives on this Greek salad, which for those of you reading who know, are pretty much the main ingredient to a Greek. So returning to the counter for probably the 4th or 5th time, I asked for olives and feta and was told they were totally out of olives. Despite this being a minor detai, it should still be mentioned at the time of ordering.

In summary:
Food Quality - 4

Service - 3
